stonetop.summary: Minor spirits of wild places, more often NPCs than monsters; these stats are for the rare times one manifests to fight.

system.concept: Minor spirits of wild places, more often NPCs than monsters; these stats are for the rare times one manifests to fight.
system.description:
These spirits mostly just do their thing, with little concern for humanity unless some mortal offends them or seeks them out for aid. An elemental spirit can:

  • Reveal what it knows, from its own perspective
  • Spread word to other spirits
  • Bestow a blessing or curse, tied to its element
  • Shift, move, or direct that which falls in its domain

Elemental spirits rarely manifest. When they do, they often possess or animate the element itself, or appear as ghostly figures somehow reflecting their element. They're more likely to be NPCs than monsters. Each stat block's HP and Armor follow the monster-creation rules (Book I p.396) for those rare manifestations; a spirit improvises elemental effects rather than a set attack, so damage and moves are left open.

The examples below are just that: examples. Feel free to modify and expand on them, or ask a character who would know what a given spirit is usually like.
